source: Bethesda 'The Slasher' release notes (2026-09-15) and Nuka Knights Patch 70 notes

changes.text: New 4-star mod Severing: +50% damage to bleeding targets.
Named unique weapons and armor can now change legendary mods and take a 4th star. Mod changes on uniques cost 10x scrip; crafting needs 30 or 65 modules plus 40 or 80 Vault Steel.
All 83 unique weapons got new innate effects and new drop sources.
Changing a mod costs a fixed 50 scrip (1 to 3 star) or 100 (4 star). Scrip sale values are 15 / 25 / 50 / 150 by star; the Purveyor sells 1 to 3 star items for 25 / 35 / 60 caps.
Night Person and Solar Powered are single-rank 2-point cards giving +5 / +5. Nocturnal Fortitude gives 50 HP per rank, Photosynthetic 3 HP/s per rank, and Lone Wanderer now reduces all damage types.
Railway Rifle holds 16 spikes (was 10) with faster semi-auto fire; Lever Action holds 6; melee swing speed bonuses are capped at +100%.
Unyielding thresholds are now exactly 20 / 40 / 60% HP. Lighter Build gives +5 AP on limbs and +10 on the torso; Ultra-Light +10 / +20. Torso Pocketed mods carry twice as much as limbs.
The Slasher runs in weekly phases from 15 September to mid November; Infestation boss health was reduced. Season 26 'Beware the Blood Moon' and Legacy Season 4 are live.
